lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-objectinputstream-readobject-no-filter
title: ObjectInputStream.readObject() without class allow-list or filter (unsafe deserialization)
summary: 'The code builds an ObjectInputStream (or a subclass such as ApplicationObjectInputStream) over
  a byte array or stream and calls readObject() with no ObjectInputFilter or class allow-list. When the
  bytes come from a request value such as the jato.clientSession parameter, a pre-authentication attacker
  can deserialize gadget chains and run arbitrary code. The fix routes deserialization through a hardened
  helper (IOUtils.deserialise) that restricts the permitted classes.

  '

rule:
  message: 'ObjectInputStream.readObject() is called on a stream with no ObjectInputFilter or class allow-list.

    If the bytes are attacker-influenced, this allows deserialization of gadget chains and remote

    code execution. Use a hardened deserialization helper that restricts classes.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: (ObjectInputStream $OIS).readObject()
    - pattern: (ApplicationObjectInputStream $OIS).readObject()
    - pattern: new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject()
    - pattern: new ApplicationObjectInputStream(...).readObject()
  - pattern-not-inside: "$RET $M(...) {\n  ...\n  $X.setObjectInputFilter(...);\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "class $C extends ObjectInputStream {\n  ...\n  Class<?> resolveClass(...) { ...\
      \ }\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Do not call readObject() on streams built from request-derived data with a plain or application

    ObjectInputStream. Deserialize through the shared hardened helper (IOUtils.deserialise), which

    enforces a class allow-list, or set an ObjectInputFilter or override resolveClass to permit only

    expected types. Prefer a non-Java-serialization format such as JSON for client-held state.

    '
  example: "public static Object deserialize(byte[] b, boolean compressed)\n        throws IOException,\
    \ ClassNotFoundException {\n    return IOUtils.deserialise(b, compressed);\n}\n"
